$Comment: What clearing the Turkey Graveyard's hard way in pays each player there at the end, beside the Great
Turkey's hard Claims, in the normal clear's shape (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear.json): the
dungeon's Rewards (Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.json) roll it into the chest where the
Great Turkey fell, full the first hard clear each day and half on later ones, counted apart from the
normal clears: every quantity halves, a leftover half paying by chance. Every roll here always pays:
Harvest Coins and festival tokens through the Currency reward kind, then Spices for Martha's dishes,
Count to CountMax an even pick, all at about three times the normal clear's.
Mmo_Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear_Hard.json adds Defense XP where MMO Skill Tree runs. A
companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear_Hard
